reader.requirement: After a successful relative WRITE whose file is named in a SAME RECORD AREA clause, the released logical record must remain available in record-name-1 (every record of its FD) and as the record of every other file of that clause (sequential or relative peers, any record shape); without the clause the area's content is not defined and is not observable.
reader.edition-search: grep EditionContext|Edition.Year|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior|ConstructRegistry in KeyedIoEmitter.cs, SequentialIoEmitter.cs (BeginReleasedRecord/EndReleasedRecord/SentRecordImage) and FileModel.SameRecordAreaPeers: none on this path; the shared record area is one backing at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness uses two sequential files; a relative record-name-1, a relative peer, a second record description of the relative FD and a failed WRITE are not exercised

probes.expected: the record released by a RANDOM relative WRITE stays in both record descriptions of its FD and in the sequential (SREC) and relative (TREC) peers of SAME RECORD AREA; a WRITE by the sequential relative peer is visible in RELF's records; the failed WRITE leaves the area as it was

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR2  (4.9.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: The records of a SAME RECORD AREA share one character backing, so the 'also available' half holds by construction; BeginReleasedRecord/EndReleasedRecord add a store only for an out-of-line record, which no 1985 record shape is.

refuter.evidence: rsra.cob at --std 85: SAME RECORD AREA FOR a RANDOM relative file (RECORD VARYING 3 TO 12 DEPENDING ON RLEN, record with OCCURS 1 TO 5 DEPENDING ON), a sequential file whose record also has an ODO, and an indexed file. WRITE RREC (RLEN 7) -> 00: RREC2 [3AABBCC     ], SREC [3AABBCC] SCNT 3 SITEM(3) CC, IREC/IKEY see the same bytes; WRITE RREC2 (RLEN 3) -> 00, RREC/SREC [1ZZ]. So an ODO record (the one 1985 variable shape) shares the one backing and the indexed peer is reached too. FileModel.IsOutOfLineRecord covers dynamic-length and pointer records only, none of which 1985 has; no edition site on the path (grep EditionContext|Edition|DialectBehavior in SequentialIoEmitter Begin/EndReleasedRecord and FileModel.SameRecordAreaPeers: none). cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR2 'also available to the program as a record of other files'.
